name: vanilla-plus-arsenal
title: Vanilla+ Arsenal
author: deadrat22
description: A curation and balance layer over standalone turret mods for vanilla+ Space Age games: the turret variety of a K2SO Arsenal stack without the modpack. All parents are optional; the mod adapts to whichever are installed. v0.2 adds K2-style vanilla turret buffs: gun-turret range 18-24 with double per-shot damage (half the ammo per kill), laser-turret range 24-28 with double per-shot damage. Both are startup settings.
